name: E-mail Organizer
tagline: Files one Gmail account by vendor and keeps invoices separate
description: A Dutch-language housekeeper for one Gmail account. Mail is labelled by the vendor that sent it, the noise is swept out of sight, and the /Payments label is kept for genuine PDF invoices. A daily pass keeps the inbox from filling back up with clutter.
author: leingoedbloed
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
